briefdescription.para: An rbus property is a name/value pair. It allows assigning a name (e.g. path) to an rbus value. An rbusProperty_t is a reference counted handle to an rbus property.

detaileddescription.para: This API is not thread-safe. All instances of types rbusValue_t, rbusProperty_t, and rbusObject_t are referenced counted. Instances of these types may have private references to other instances of these types. There are read methods in this api that return references to these private instances. There are write methods in this api that release current references and retain new ones. When this happens any reference held by the user becomes unlinked from the parent instance. The instance will also be destroyed unless the user retains it for themselves.
